name: malo-browser
description: Agent browser runtime and scripted web demo tool: a daemon hands out port leases with isolated, profile-backed browser sessions that agents drive through 27 session tools (snapshots with iframe content, typed input, login handoff, network capture), plus a visible Electron stage, hidden 1080p30 recording with evidence files, a director console and a loopback control API.

description_i18n.en: Agent browser runtime and scripted web demo tool: a daemon hands out port leases with isolated, profile-backed browser sessions that agents drive through 27 session tools (snapshots with iframe content, typed input, login handoff, network capture), plus a visible Electron stage, hidden 1080p30 recording with evidence files, a director console and a loopback control API.
description_i18n.zh-CN: agent 浏览器运行时兼脚本化网页演示工具：守护进程按端口发放租约，提供隔离且可复用登录态的 session，agent 用 27 个 session 工具驱动（含 iframe 内容的快照、逐字输入、登录交接、网络抓包）；另有可见的 Electron 演示舞台、无头 1080p30 录制与证据文件、导演控制台与本地控制 API。
